_meta.notes: Casa Zen is the long-standing Zen presence in Costa Rica. It publishes a postal box rather than a street address, so the pin resolves only to Santo Domingo de Heredia.

places.name: Casa Zen de Costa Rica
places.notes: The community’s site describes a Zen practice center in Santo Tomás de Heredia with zazen, retreats, ceremonies, and training. A current street address and detailed timetable were not published, so the marker remains town-level and visitors should contact the center.
